review_note: Visually inspected the cover: A BILL, [Date of Commencement], no adopted enacted replacement asserted.
Read actual body s.749 on physical 702, plus repeal/savings physical 699-701. Gazette appointment is a held prerequisite; the contents numbering is not substituted.
Read cached current homepage promotion: labels reform an Act and advertises unified registry, five-day processing and ownership threshold. Draft does not adopt those advertised procedures.
NIB s.50 expressly repeals Companies Act ss.2-14 and substitutes NIB for CAC. Corrects the predecessor OARG assertion.
NIB s.23(1)-(2) assigns company administration and incorporation supervision to the Corporate Affairs Directorate.
2009 s.15(2) permits one person for a private company; 2014 s.2 deletes the subject-to words in s.15(1), not the one-person limb. Officers remain a separate question.
Read ss.18-20: shares/guarantee/unlimited liabilities and public/private categories are distinct.
Read s.19(1)-(5). Member cap, specified employee exclusions and joint-holder treatment are preserved. No popularity inference is made.
Read 2009 s.22 objects, distribution restrictions and 2014 s.4 replacement of (2). Historical existing-company transition does not establish a new current application rule.
2014 s.5(a) replaces all s.23(2)(a), specifying private-company shares and 25% subscriptions, without repeating old fixed monetary amounts. No invented public minimum.
2014 s.21 inserts public in s.85(2)-(3); does not change (1) or (4). Awkward payment language is expressly held.
Read 2009 s.85(4), s.85(3), and s.88 continuation physical 42-43. Subject-to branches remain qualified; no cash-payment assertion is inferred.
Read s.211 and 2014 s.43. Public inserted only in (1)-(2); unchanged liability (3) is held, rather than silently extended or removed.
Read ss.249-251. Secretary baseline, reasonable knowledge/experience steps, additional public-company qualifications and same-person joint-act prohibition are supported.
Read s.23(1)-(5) together with 2014 s.5. Memorandum particulars/witnessing supported; old deed-stamping subsection expressly repealed.
Read s.31(1)-(4). Signed witnessed subscriptions, consecutive paragraphs and optional Table A adoption supported.
Read s.32(1)-(3): full office, first officers, subscription/compliance declarations, further lawful documents and no postal-box substitution.
2014 s.10 adds first-director valid ID/consent and subscriber-ID declaration. No new fabricated filing field.
Read s.34(1)-(3): incorporation date creates personality; certificate prima facie rather than a guarantee of all licences.
2014 s.11 replaces refusal deadline with reasonable period. Draft correctly avoids treating it as a successful-incorporation turnaround promise.
Read ss.317-321 and 2014 ss.55-56. Distinct return classes, 28-day completion and signed forwarding supported. Printed s.318 certificate cross-reference held.
Read s.185(1)-(3). Annual/15-month and first 18-month qualification, extension exclusion and auditors/all voting members written dispensation supported; post-waiver filing held.
Read ss.281-282: sufficient accounting, goods/stock records, in-country location and six years from creation; disposal-direction qualification remains in the source.
Read s.288(1)-(5) and 2014 s.54. Annual IFRS, private content exceptions, general audit and literal notwithstanding (5) anomaly correctly held.

REPAIR: the claimed all-conditions summary omits government/public corporation/agency nominees in s.302(1)(e), and s.302(2) prorates the turnover maximum where the company year is not a full year. Add these to Guide/ledger; current cap and audit cross-reference remain held.
Read s.296(1)-(5): first 18 months, then annual, nine-month freshness and annual-return delivery; reference to the particular unlimited exception avoids blanket exemption.
2014 s.55 prints Le850,000 daily for company and each officer in default. Historical amount is explicitly not a payable current currency amount; ss.61-62 levying/priority interactions held.

Read ss.484-486: new establishment one month, commencement transition distinct, constitution/translation, addresses/officers/process recipient and existence evidence, later three-month changes, annual local balance sheet.
Read actual RAA s.21(1)-(5) across physical 16/15 and neighbouring ss.22-24. Fifteen-day income-activity trigger, no second TIN and separate GST registration supported.

Read cached registration text and HTML anchors. One shareholder/director is website context, not stronger law. Main registration CTA href is #; separate header business-portal link is not treated as tested authenticated filing.
Read NRA s.2 continuation/body corporate; no reliance only on repealed 2002 law.
Read NRA ss.15 and 42. Revenue administration/enforcement functions and repeal with saved instruments supported.
Read entire one-page Bank notice, table and prospective wording. 1000:1 supported; no 2021 legal-introduction date inferred.
Read ITA ss.45-47. Ordinary year, written application/Commissioner permission, substituted-year withdrawal and transitional period supported as baseline only.

Read ITA ss.10-16. Ordinary/temporary/non-resident scope, individual time qualifications, company alternative residence grounds and separate PE treatment remain routed to preserved cross-border Guide.
Same actual RAA s.21 reading as F29. Activity trigger is distinguished from incorporation and GST.
Same visually inspected bill cover and body s.749 as F01-F02; company-law currentness is held.
Cached registration page invokes 2009 law whereas homepage advertises replacement. Neither resolves enacted/commenced status.
